source.description:
## PROBLEM
Changelog fragments need a coherent release narrative.
## SUCCESS
Core and Specialists release notes precisely cover injection, policy, prompt integrity, RPC, mandatory rules, traversal hardening, routing enforcement, compatibility and known limits.
## SCOPE
Core and Specialists CHANGELOG.md and release-body text.
## NON_GOALS
No tag or publish.
## CONSTRAINTS
SCRUTINY: high. Exact package/version names and hashes.
## LIBRARIES
N/A — changelog synthesis.
## VALIDATION
- [ ] Every shipped behavior represented once.
- [ ] Tightening and known limits explicit.
## OUTPUT
Reviewed changelog commits and release body.
source.title: changelog-keeper: write precise cross-repository release notes
